item.title: Apple Plans Return to Server Market With Potential Nvidia Partnership
item.description:
Apple Plans Return to Server Market With Potential Nvidia Partnership

Apple is planning to re-enter the server market, potentially partnering with Nvidia to develop the new hardware.

🔍 Overview

Apple retired its Xserve line in 2011 and has since largely left enterprise machines to other manufacturers. This new development follows the popularity of the Mac Mini and Mac Studio among AI developers, which has led to shortages.

⚙️ Key details

  • Hardware: The servers are rumored to run on either two or four M8 Ultra chips, depending on the model.
  • Integration: The servers could incorporate Nvidia’s NVLink Fusion technology, which allows multiple chips to connect and operate as one.
  • Context: Apple recently utilized Nvidia chips to power its revamped Siri servers.

🚀 Availability

  • Expected Debut: Likely not until 2029.
  • Chip Timeline: The M8 line is still a ways out, as Apple only announced the M6 in August.

#Apple #Nvidia #EnterpriseHardware #AI #M8Ultra

Source: Apple might make servers again to cash in on the AI rush

item.title: Perplexity Portable Computer Launches on NVIDIA RTX Workstations
item.description:
Perplexity Portable Computer Launches on NVIDIA RTX Workstations

Perplexity has released its Portable Computer agent for Windows PCs equipped with NVIDIA GeForce RTX and NVIDIA RTX PRO Workstations. This update brings multistep AI workflows to local hardware, allowing users to analyze files, cross-reference documents, and manage recurring tasks without sensitive data leaving their device.

🧩 How it works

Perplexity Portable Computer functions as an on-device sibling to the cloud-based Perplexity Computer. It features a simplified installation process that includes the model, runtime, and computer tooling in a single package. While the agent runs locally, it includes a clear off-ramp for tasks requiring higher reasoning; if a request exceeds the local model’s capabilities, the agent prompts the user for permission before routing the task to a cloud-based model.

⚙️ Key details

  • Default Model: The agent utilizes a Qwen 3.8 27B model, post-trained by Perplexity and tuned for NVIDIA RTX GPUs.
  • Hardware Requirements: Requires a GPU with 24GB or more of VRAM.
  • Cloud Credits: Local execution does not consume Perplexity Computer cloud credits.
  • Integrations: The agent features built-in connectors for several common platforms:
Connector Application
Microsoft Outlook Email
Microsoft OneDrive File Storage
Microsoft Word Document Editing
Google Drive File Storage
Gmail Email
Slack Communication
GitHub Software Development

💡 Why it matters

According to Gerardo Delgado of NVIDIA, “As local models become more capable, AI agents can handle more work directly on a PC while keeping sensitive information on the device.” The release allows users to bypass the technical complexity of assembling their own AI stacks. By running agents locally, Perplexity aims to support high-value workflows in sectors such as engineering, finance, and product analytics that involve regulated or sensitive data.

🚀 Availability

The software is currently available for Windows PCs running NVIDIA GeForce RTX and NVIDIA RTX PRO Workstations with at least 24GB of VRAM. Support for NVIDIA DGX Station is expected to follow the initial release.

#Perplexity #NVIDIA #AIAgents #LocalAI #Workstations

Source: Perplexity brings on-device Portable Computer agent to Windows RTX PCs

item.title: Hostinger Launches GPU Hosting for AI Development
item.description:
Hostinger Launches GPU Hosting for AI Development

Hostinger has introduced GPU Hosting, providing direct access to NVIDIA GPUs with a deployment process designed to be simpler than traditional hyperscalers.

⚙️ Key details

Users maintain control of the server environment through full root, terminal, and SSH access. To streamline setup, the service allows for the launch of preconfigured AI applications that include necessary drivers, containers, and dependencies.

Management and usage monitoring are handled via the Hostinger dashboard, and live availability is displayed before deployment.

💰 Pricing and Billing

Hostinger uses an hourly credit model that meters GPU usage per minute with no long-term commitment. Key billing details include:

  • Continuous Billing: Charges continue as long as the instance exists, including during idle periods.
  • Stopping Charges: Destroying the instance is currently the only way to stop compute charges.
  • Data Transfer: There are no egress charges for transferring generated data out of the instance.

🚀 Availability

There are currently six instance options across five GPU models:

GPU Model VRAM Price per Hour
RTX 4090 24GB $0.38
RTX PRO 6000 Server 96GB $0.60
L40S 48GB $0.92
A100 80GB PCIe 80GB $1.43
B200 192GB $4.50
B200 Dedicated 192GB $7.08

💡 Why it matters

Different GPU options support various AI workloads:

  • RTX 4090: The most accessible starting point for workloads requiring 24GB of VRAM.
  • A100: Provides 80GB of VRAM for memory-intensive inference and training.
  • B200: Offers 192GB of VRAM for large-model inference and training at scale.

#Hostinger #NVIDIA #GPU #AIInfrastructure #CloudComputing

Source: 10 best GPU cloud providers for AI and machine learning

item.title: Apple Unveils iPhone Duo Foldable and iPhone 18 Pro Lineup
item.description:
Apple Unveils iPhone Duo Foldable and iPhone 18 Pro Lineup

At the “Surprise and Shine” event in Cupertino on September 9, Apple officially unveiled a new generation of hardware, including its first foldable iPhone, the iPhone Duo, alongside the iPhone 18 Pro series, Apple Watch Series 12, Apple Watch Ultra 4, and AirPods 5. AI serves as the common thread across this new ecosystem.

📱 iPhone Duo

The iPhone Duo is Apple’s first foldable iPhone, featuring a Grade 5 titanium build and a precision-engineered hinge with more than 100 components.

  • Displays: A 7.6-inch Super Retina XDR inner display (more than 50% larger than the iPhone 18 Pro Max) and a 5.4-inch external display.
  • Durability: IP68 rating and Ceramic Shield 2 on the outer display, which Apple claims has up to three times greater scratch resistance than the previous generation.
  • Performance: Powered by the A20 Pro chip, utilizing a dual-battery architecture and a vapor-chamber cooling system.
  • Display Tech: Supports ProMotion and Always-On capabilities with a peak outdoor brightness of 3,000 nits.
  • Expanded Utility: Support for Apple Pencil USB-C is coming later this year for sketching, note-taking, and document annotation.

📸 iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max

These models focus on AI, battery life, performance, and camera capabilities, powered by the A20 Pro chip and a new-generation vapor-chamber cooling system for high sustained performance.

  • Camera System: Features a 48MP Fusion main camera with variable aperture. The system can automatically optimize aperture for depth of field and lighting, or users can manually select from four levels.
  • Video and Audio: Supports 4K Dolby Vision HDR time-lapse and cinematic effects applied after recording at up to 60 fps. Audio Mix has been improved for voice processing.
  • Imaging: Additional Photographic Styles controls for image grain and texture.

⌚ Apple Watch Series 12

Powered by the S11 chip, the Series 12 introduces a Health Sensing System combining electrical and optical sensors to measure heart rate variability (HRV) and heart rate every five seconds.

  • AI Integration: watchOS 27 brings Siri AI to the device to combine personal context with broader knowledge. New Audio Intelligence capabilities will arrive later this year.
  • Materials: Available in aluminum, titanium, and a ceramic option (available in Night and Pearl White).

⚙️ Key Details

Product Colors Storage / Materials Price / Availability
iPhone Duo Star White, Night Sky 256GB to 2TB Starts at $1,999; Sales Oct 23
iPhone 18 Pro / Pro Max Black, Silver, Glacier, Burgundy N/A Retail availability Sept 18

🚀 Availability

  • iPhone Duo: Pre-orders begin October 16; sales start October 23. Available in more than 70 countries, including Vietnam.
  • iPhone 18 Pro / Pro Max: Pre-orders begin September 12; retail availability starts September 18. Vietnam is included in first-wave pre-orders.

#Apple #iPhoneDuo #iPhone18Pro #AppleWatch #AI

Source: Apple Unveils New Product Lineup: Foldable iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro, Apple Watch Series 12 and AirPods 5 - TechTimes.vn

item.title: Marvell to Showcase AI Data Center Connectivity and Memory Solutions
item.description:
Marvell to Showcase AI Data Center Connectivity and Memory Solutions

Marvell Technology, Inc. has announced it will present its portfolio of AI data center connectivity and memory solutions at the AI Infra Summit 2026, taking place September 15 to 17 in Santa Clara, California.

⚙️ Key details

Marvell will highlight advances in its end-to-end data center connectivity portfolio for scale-up, scale-out, and scale-across applications at Booth #704. The showcase includes:

Solution Function/Capability
Marvell® Photonic Fabric™ Technology Enables memory sharing across multiple racks, extending scale beyond traditional distance constraints
Marvell RELIANT™ Interconnect Telemetry Platform Provides real-time visibility into the health and performance of AI data center infrastructure connectivity across optical and electrical links
Marvell Teralynx® T100 102 Tbps Ethernet switch device delivering increased bandwidth and efficiency for large-scale AI networks
PCIe 6.0 Switch 256-lane design to connect more accelerators and devices within scale-up AI systems
CXL-based memory solutions Supports expansion, compression, pooling, and near-memory acceleration to reduce dataset movement between XPUs and accelerate large-scale vector databases
DPUs and Ethernet switching Deliver high-performance access to NVMe storage across the network
PCIe® 6.0 NVMe SSD controller Optimized for next-generation enterprise and AI storage

🔍 Overview

During the summit, Marvell executives will participate in panels and presentations regarding connectivity and networking for next-generation AI data center infrastructure. This includes a keynote presentation titled “AI Inference at Scale” delivered by Dave Lazovsky, Executive Vice President and General Manager of the Data Center Networking Business Group.

#Marvell #AIDataCenter #Semiconductors #Networking #AIInfraSummit

Source: Marvell to Showcase End-to-End AI Data Center Connectivity Portfolio at AI Infra Summit 2026
